entities.summary: Berthe Jeanne Euphrosyne Wilhelmine Cabra née Gheude de Contreras was a Belgian married to Commander Alphonse Cabra of the Belgian army and the first European woman to travel across Africa from west to east over land. She made her journeys between 1905 and 1906.
